text_sanskrit: भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः । अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च ॥ १-८ ॥
itrans: bhavAnbhIShmashcha karNashcha kR^ipashcha samiti~njayaH . ashvatthAmA vikarNashcha saumadattistathaiva cha .. 1-8 ..
translation: Thyself and Bhishma, and Karna, and Kripa the victorious in battle, Aswathama, and Vikarna ; so also (Bhurisravas) the son of Somadatta;
